budget_items.topic: Capital requests tentatively approved by the Capital Planning Committee
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The committee tentatively approved nine capital requests totaling $650K, not yet formally approved, with a January 8 meeting to go through the process.

budget_items.topic: Engine 4 fire truck and Rescue 2 requests
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Two large requests not formally approved and possibly not to be: an engine 4 fire truck at $685K and Rescue 2 at around $350K.
budget_items.quote: an engine 4 fire truck at $685k and rescue 2 at around $350k.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Engine 4 had a pump problem; $15,500 was spent to repair the existing pump, versus an estimated $30K to replace it; the chief is wary of spending $15K more on a 24-year-old vehicle.
budget_items.quote: engine 4 has had a pump problem, he spent $15,500 to repair the existing pump chief sullivan could have spent $30k to replace the pump.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Seven requests for FY20-FY24 total $2.9 million, averaging about $725K per year, which may be manageable given the town has funded $600K-$800K requests without borrowing.
